content.comment_body: This link is helpful, but it's quite complex for beginners. Is there a simple list or table showing [product_name] family compatibility?

There isn't a table available. If you're not planning to use older [product_name] units prior to [version_no], here's what you need to know: Devices before [version_no] cannot use expansion modules. Devices from [version_no] can use expansion modules, but only if the [article_no] of the expansion module ends with specific codes. Compatibility changes depending on the ending of the [article_no], so please check the details. For the latest [version_no], compatibility is only guaranteed if the expansion module's [article_no] ends with a certain code. I've attached a short history for the recent versions.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking a concise and accessible overview of module compatibility within the [product_name] hardware family. The current information is scattered and challenging for newcomers, especially regarding which versions and expansion modules are compatible with each other.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want a clear and easy-to-read compatibility table for [product_name] modules to quickly determine which combinations work, reducing confusion and mistakes for those who are new to the hardware.
